text:
Scheduled cost is $119.40 (11,940 cents) for ten periods. The plan misses 63 of the 239 (episode, follower) pairs. That is the best I found by hand; I did not prove no plan misses fewer.

**How I built it:** with at most two optional services open on any day, I treated the plan as two back-to-back chains of one-month periods.

**Chain A**
- **Pebble Kids, Nov 11.** It continues the paid access, which already covers Crooked Signal ep1. The period covers Crooked Signal ep2–6 and Hollow Tide ep1–2.
- **Kestrel+, Dec 11.** It covers Distant Tide ep2–6. Ep1 is missed, and Sami misses ep2.
- **Tidewell, Jan 11.** It covers the Glass Archive drop on Jan 20.
- **Northline, Feb 11 and Mar 11.** They cover Salt Kingdom, Glass Signal and Crooked Atlas. Sami misses ep1 of both weekly shows, because his 3-day window closes Feb 7.

**Chain B**
- **Orbit, Nov 9 and Dec 9.** They cover all of Paper Signal and Crooked Lantern ep1–4.
- **Lumen, Jan 9 and Feb 9.** They cover Salt Garden ep2 for Dana and Ines, and ep3–11 for everyone. Ep1 is missed, and Sami misses ep2.
- **Kestrel+, Mar 9.** It covers the Amber Orchard drop. Mar 9 is the last day of Sami's window.

I checked every day: no more than two optional services are ever open at once. No period overlaps another period or already-paid access, and every start falls within the plan dates.

**What is missed (63 pairs):**

| Title | Missed pairs | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| The Amber Archive | 14 | All episodes |
| The Crooked Lantern | 9 | Ep5–7 |
| The Distant Tide | 4 | Ep1 for all; ep2 for Sami |
| The Crooked Signal | 6 | Ep7–8 |
| The Hollow Tide | 6 | Ep3–8 |
| The Quiet Meridian | 7 | All episodes |
| The Copper Orchard | 11 | All episodes |
| The Salt Garden | 4 | Ep1 for all; ep2 for Sami |
| Salt Kingdom and Glass Signal | 2 | Ep1 for Sami |

**Alternatives I checked that miss more:**
- Paying Pebble in December instead of Kestrel+.
- Starting Tidewell earlier so Northline can start by Feb 7.
- Giving Orbit a second period into late January.
- Running Lumen for three periods.
